section1.secondSquareP: Navigate the longest underground river in Europe
section1.thirdSquareP: You will be accompanied by local guides who are experts in the area

section2.firstH3: Enjoy a relaxing boat ride through one of the most spectacular underground rivers.
section2.secondH3: You will travel 800 meters by boat.
section2.thirdH3: Did you know it is the longest navigable underground river in Europe?

section4.thirdH3: The experience takes place in the province of Castellón, a region we know perfectly and where we offer the best tourist routes.

section5.secondH3: Departure from Plaza de La Reina in Valencia, corner of Calle del Mar.
section5.thirdH3: Private transport to La Vall d'Uixó (Castellón)
section5.fifthH3: Return to Valencia by private transport

indexSection5.secondH3: Explore the magical Caves of San José and enjoy an unforgettable boat ride

steps.title: Meeting point
steps.description: We will depart from Valencia (maximum 10 people), traveling by car for approximately 40 minutes to the town of La Vall d'Uixó (Castellón).

steps.title: Arrival at the Caves
steps.description: Once there, we will begin the tour inside the cave, which will last about 40 minutes at a constant temperature of 20°C.

steps.title: Exploration
steps.description: The tour consists of 800 meters by boat and 250 meters on foot. There is no risk or dangerous situation during the visit.

steps.title: Unique experience
steps.description: Dare to enjoy something different and special. Feel the sensation that time has stopped in a very special atmosphere.

steps.title: Return
steps.description: At the end of the visit, we will return to Valencia to the starting point.

card.title: Caves of San José
card.description: Discover the Caves of San José on a magical boat ride along the longest underground river in Europe. A unique experience from Valencia!
